question: Apis cerana indica is a type of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bee**__.

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• **Pollinators **of many crops like sunflower, Brassica, apple and pear are **bees**. So keeping beehives in crop fields during the flowering period increases crop yield as well as honey yield.
 
• Bee-keeping or apiculture is the maintenance of hives of honeybees for the production of honey.
 
• **Bee-keeping** is a practice in any area where there is the availability of sufficient bee pastures of some wild shrubs, fruit orchids and cultivated crops.
 
• One of the most common species of bees that can be reared is **Apis cerana indica**.
 
• Apis cerana indica is a type of bee commonly known as the **Indian bee**.
